name: alien-carriers
notes: The Thornwake carriers: the boss art direction v2 (R8, plan/operator-feedback-2026-11-15b.md; styleguide docs/styleguide/alien-capital-ships.md; openspec/changes/boss-hero-assets/design.md section 10). Input of tools/rigkit (rig.py, bake.py) and tools/rigsheet. Units are arena units. Ship frame: x = screen right, y = aft (the prow points -y, toward the player), z = up. Plane frame ('face' in v1 files): [ax, ay, n] on the plane through the carrier centre that faces the hero camera (pitch 45, yaw 0): ax, ay are hero-view screen units and n is the distance toward the camera; the functional windows live on it, so they hold at every pitch and swerve. A module is a slot (shared fields and common prims) plus one of its sets (set prims). A hull lists its slots and picks a set per slot; one bake per hull (= per set combination). Prims and generators: see tools/rigkit/rigkit.py prim_geometry and array_geometry.

views.belly_notes: The underside seen from below and in front, for the boss-grandeur Overflight (the hull passes over the ship): one finished image, not a layered view set (rig.py --views belly --envelope off).
views.stored_notes: carrier-v3 (design 2.1): one stored view (45, 0), bent at runtime, plus the belly. The 3 x 3 clay is rendered for review sheets only (rig.py --views review).

render.envelope_notes: Carrier-relative arena rect that can ever reach the screen: carrier x in [82, 278], y in [189, 221] (glide), camera zoom down to Z = 0.70 about (180, 477) shows arena x in [-77, 437] and y from -204. Geometry outside is never rendered or stored (the budget-by-visible-region rule, boss-hero-assets ledger 4.3 lesson 5). carrier-v3 (design 6.2): each hull carries its own envelope (tours 2-5 frame wider at their lower zoom floors); render.envelope is the fallback. Tours 2-5 render 40 units of overscan past their visible envelope (hulls.<h>.visible), so a collapse or a bend never shows a cut edge (operator round 3b C3).

sinew.notes: living tissue between and under the scales; glows ember once exposed

dark.notes: core maw, bays, hangar maws: the scene draws their glow

scale.notes: carrier-v3: the darker scale field of carrier4-shroud (tag_map plate -> scale; the pale plate clay painted as teeth): shed at S2 like plate

palettes.notes: Value bands per material, so each reads at phone size: chitin dark mid, bone light, crystal violet glow, ember hot orange, membrane wine. Cyan is the force-shield overlay language (alien-insignia) and is never baked into a hull.

originality.notes: Checked by rig.py --check on titles, slot and set names, notes and prompts. References (StarCraft, Star Wars, Star Trek capital ships) inform scale, silhouette language and detail density only.

prompts.hero: Repaint this grey clay model as a finished, highly detailed painted game sprite of a colossal alien bio-organic carrier warship seen from above and in front, in the style of a high-resolution sci-fi capital ship concept painting. Materials: dark violet-black chitin carapace in overlapping organic scales and long armour strakes, satin and weathered like old horn, never glossy, with dusky violet highlights on the edges, ivory bone spines, ribs and thorns, dark wine-red membranes stretched between ribs, glowing violet psionic crystal growths where the clay is violet, small hot ember-orange glowing organic gun ports where the clay is orange. The weapons are grown bone thorns and glowing pores, not machinery. Only the three black rectangles are openings: deep black empty hangar mouths; everything around them is solid armoured chitin. Organic, alien, ancient and menacing, enormous scale with dense fine detail, no metal panels, no windows. Keep the outline, every shape, the pose and the viewing angle exactly. Solid flat green background (#00FF00), no checkerboard, no shadow.
prompts.hero_set_thorn: The armour is jagged and thorny, bristling with racks of bone thorn blades and long armour strakes.
prompts.hero_set_lattice: Violet crystal lattices grow through the carapace in columns and veins, glowing softly.
prompts.hero_set_shroud: The carapace is smooth and layered like overlapping beetle wing cases, heavy and armoured.
prompts.stage_S1: Same ship, same pose, framing and colours. The violet crystals flicker dim and cracked; scorched soot streaks and fine glowing ember hairline cracks spread across the chitin scales. The black hangar openings stay black and empty, no fire inside them. Keep the green background.
prompts.stage_S2: Same ship, same pose and framing. The armour scales are torn away in many places, exposing glowing ember-red sinew and bone ribs underneath; the violet crystal pylons are shattered stumps; small fires and sparks along the torn edges. The black hangar openings stay black and empty, no fire inside them. Keep the green background.
prompts.stage_S3: Same ship, same pose and framing, now breaking apart: deep molten cracks through the carapace, broken spines and snapped ribs, burning breaches, black smoke wisps inside the hull outline. The black hangar openings stay black and empty, no fire inside them. Keep the green background.
prompts.hero_tour_2: Bigger and more armed: hot brood light glows deep inside the flank hangar maws, and a second battery of gun blisters lines each prong.
prompts.hero_tour_3: Heavier still: thick layered armour with glowing ember seams, palisades of bone stakes walling the hangar deck, barbed tendrils trailing from the prong tips.
prompts.hero_tour_4: Scarred, thicker plating, crowns of spikes on every terrace, translucent brood sacs glowing from within, three batteries of gun blisters.
prompts.hero_tour_5: The darkest chitin with molten seams, a blazing crown of great violet crystal blades on the citadel, every surface bristling with thorns and gun ports.
prompts.refine: Same image, same composition, same colours and lighting. Add fine surface detail: chitin scale edges, tiny bone thorns, membrane veins, crystal facets. Keep every shape, edge and dark opening exactly where it is. Keep the green background.

prow.notes: The launch gallery in the throat between the forward prongs, on the hero plane: the core maw and both bays as one hangar deck behind solid bulkheads, the two gun blisters on the sill below. Never detaches (it carries the simulation windows); it breaks only in S4. Head-reading guard: no thin repeated vertical bars, no rows of beads, no arcs over the openings, no paired bright features above them.

thorn.notes: Racks of flat bone thorn blades jut sideways from both ends of the deck, like a ram. carrier-v3: the deck dome carries a staggered field of small pores (9 + 8 per row) and low shingles instead of four big plates per row, which painted as paired eye ports.

lattice.notes: A row of violet crystal columns grows up out of the deck between bone struts.

shroud.notes: A staggered field of small overlapping wing-case scales armours the deck top: texture, never a pair of shapes (a pair above the gallery reads as brows).

spire.notes: carrier-v3, tour 3: the lattice prow with neither the bone strut row nor the crystal column row (both painted as teeth over the deck at this extent; ledger v2 section 5, and a crystal row turned up and back still painted as a hanging fringe, run log 3026000-07); only the two side crystals.

bastion.notes: carrier-v3, tour 4: the shroud prow with long overlapping chitin wing cases over the deck instead of the scale pebbles (which painted pale and tooth-like).

carapace.notes: The hull mass: a flat, wide-fronted wedge slab stepping up in terraces, with two forward prongs that embrace the arena. Linear fore-and-aft plating carries the scale (a ship's detail language in grown materials). Goes last in S4 (its wreck is its own S3 layer sinking into the fog).

ridged.notes: A bone keel along the top terrace and long fore-and-aft armour strakes on every terrace.

lobed.notes: Long low armoured bulges ride the terraces, veined with violet crystal.

shroud.notes: Long overlapping wing-case plates run fore and aft over the terraces, edged in small bone thorns.

wing.notes: Outer arms beyond the prongs: they spill off the screen edges and hook forward around the arena.

scythe.notes: A flat swept scythe arm, thorned on its outer edge, scaled on top.

fan.notes: Five bone ribs fan out from the flank with dark membranes stretched between.

lobe.notes: A chain of three armoured lobes, each crested with thorns, ending in a hooked claw.

spines.notes: The dorsal growths above the citadel: the first thing to break off (S3).

ridge.notes: Great bone spines down the keel, swept aft, and two smaller rows.

crown.notes: A crown of psionic crystal pillars erupting from the citadel.

forest.notes: A dense field of short bone thorns over the whole slab.

emitter.notes: Shield emitters in a row of three along each flank: their crystals are the shield's source and shatter when it falls (S2). A row, never a single pair: a lone pair of glows reads as a head.

spire.notes: A tall crystal spire on each base.

lattice.notes: A splayed pair of crystals on each base.

veil.notes: A long crystal blade lying swept aft on each base, cupped by a bone finger.

blister.notes: A battery of visual gun blisters along each prong (gameplay turrets stay the prow's two pivots). Later tours add more batteries.

thorn.notes: Twin bone gun-thorns per blister, pointing at the player.

crystal.notes: A crystal lens crowns each blister.

hive.notes: Each blister is a ribbed hive mound with twin ember ports.

maw.notes: Flank launch maws (tour 2+), carrier-v3 gates mawL/mawR at (+-228, -40): an elongated black well along the flank under chitin lids. Closed: the lids meet; open: they part (slit) or sink away (iris). The brood light inside is drawn at runtime, never baked. Elongated along the flank, never round: a round dark socket pair reads as a head.

slit.notes: A long slit under two chitin lids that part.

iris.notes: An oval well under one domed chitin lid that sinks away into the hull.

barrier.notes: Spiked armour barriers on the prongs (tour 3+), walling the throat around the prow.

wall.notes: Stacked armour plates standing on the prong, crested with thorns.

palisade.notes: A palisade of tall bone stakes leaning inward over the throat.

tendril.notes: Tendrils curling out from under the prong tips (tour 3+), mostly beyond the screen edge.

sac.notes: Brood sacs (tour 4+), carrier-v3 gates sacL/sacR at (+-262, -118): a membrane sac in two halves over a black well, between two smaller sealed sacs. Open = split: the halves part along the flank. The brood light inside is runtime.

cluster.notes: One splitting sac and two sealed ones in a row along the flank.

crown.notes: The psionic crown on the citadel (tour 5): a ring of great crystal blades around a central spire.

blaze.notes: Nine leaning crystal blades and a central spire.

gate.notes: carrier-v3 gates (design 4.1): armoured launch hatches at the CarrierGate positions (carrier_gates.dart; the anchor gate holds them within 3 units). Plane frame, dropped onto the hull along the hero view, never scaled with the hull. Closed: chitin leaves flush with the armour over a black well; open (the 'open' matrices): the leaves slide apart and sink under the jambs. The runtime blends the two baked states and draws the telegraph lights and the rail chase. Head-reading guard: no bright parts, the rail is dark sinew.

leaf.notes: Prong and aft gates: two leaves between tapered jambs, a sinew launch rail below.

bay.notes: The deck bays (the prow's side hatches at +-46): two leaves over the bay, sliding under the jamb and the bulkhead.

pod.notes: The prong gates at (+-150, 52): a chitin sponson arm from the deck corner out under the prong root (the gate sits in the throat corner, where the hull had none; the arm reaches the prongs at every extent), with the leaf gate on its face.

hatch.notes: carrier-v3 dorsal compartments (tour 3+) on the citadel terrace: creatures rise out of them, then swoop. Closed: an armoured lid over a black pit; open: the lid swings up toward the camera on its aft hinge.

slab.notes: One slab lid hinged at its aft edge.

petal.notes: Two leaves hinged at the fore and aft edges, swinging up and apart.

S0.notes: shielded: intact; cyan hex cells are a runtime overlay

S1.notes: shield failing: a runtime scorch and crystal-flicker overlay on the S0 layers (boss-grandeur design 6, S1); not baked (budget decision, ledger C3)

S2.notes: armour shedding: every scale and emitter crystal gone, sinew exposed

S3.notes: module loss: the first detach group breaks off

budget.notes: Resident RGBA of one hull (one set combination) <= 16 MB: S0 layers at their texel class (core 2.0 px/unit: the prow; mass 1.0: everything else), S1-S3 layers at x stage_scale, wrecks at their class, mirrored pairs once, everything clipped to render.envelope. Measured by rigsheet budget from the manifest.

selected.notes: Picked raws (paths under root); ledger plan/render-runs/boss-carrier-v2.md. sym = the hero half mirrored onto the other (yaw -12 draws +12 mirrored).

field.notes: carrier-v3 3.2: the 12 field regions as Voronoi seeds (hero-view arena units, CarrierRegion order); rigsheet fielddata bakes R = signed distance (+-32 units), G = region id, B = height at 0.5 px per unit over the envelope.
